description: This file defines the PurgeEntitiesResponse class, which represents the response to a purge entities command within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating instances indicating success or failure, parsing from JSON, and managing response metadata.

classes.name: PurgeEntitiesResponse
classes.description: Represents the response received after a purge entities command, encapsulating the entity type and success status, with methods for JSON serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: PurgeEntitiesResponse.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains JSON field definitions for serializing and deserializing PurgeEntitiesResponse objects.

methods.name: successful
methods.description: Creates a response indicating a successful purge of entities.

methods.name: failed
methods.description: Creates a response indicating a failed purge of entities.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON object into a PurgeEntitiesResponse instance.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the type of the entities involved in the purge.

methods.name: isSuccessful
methods.description: Returns whether the purge was successful.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified DittoHeaders.
